posts.title: PRty time
posts.description: Being a professional developer, I’ve been working with Pull Requests a lot. We have a microservices architecture, so at any given day I am reviewer on several PRs, and also I have several PRs open myself, waiting for others to review. It’s easy to lose track of notifications, or even of PRs themselves altogether.
